purpose: Teach: 公用/専売/敬称/埋め立て/買い取り/廉価/覚書/即日

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 公用文書のテンプレートを整備しましょう
lines.en: Let's get the official document templates standardized.
lines.style: Brisk, efficient tone. Light snap on the opening syllable. Forward momentum—no hesitation. The voice of someone who has already thought through this step. Direct eye contact level.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。専売契約の更新案を準備しました
lines.en: Yes—I've prepared the renewal proposal for the exclusive contract.
lines.style: Responsive and attentive. Quick acknowledgment on 「はい」, then straightforward report. No embellishment. Solid, dependable delivery—the tone of someone showing up with what was asked for.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社外文書の敬称表記をマニュアル化しましょう
lines.en: We should standardize the honorific forms for external documents.
lines.style: Clear directive tone. Slightly higher priority than the previous request—a touch more emphasis on standardization. Measured pace. Collaborative 'we'—inviting rather than commanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。埋め立て地域への新店舗計画を検討中です
lines.en: Yes—we're currently reviewing the new store plan for the reclaimed area.
lines.style: Steady status update. Acknowledgment first, then the substance. Matter-of-fact, no defensiveness. Shows progress in motion. Small pause before the new information, like ticking through a mental checklist.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 競合店の買い取り提案を作成しましょう
lines.en: Let's draft the buyout proposal for the competitor store.
lines.style: Clear task assignment. Slightly firmer than earlier requests—this one matters strategically. Even pace, no rushing. The tone of delegating something substantial but manageable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。廉価ラインの試作品を発注しました
lines.en: Yes—I've placed the order for the low-price-line prototypes.
lines.style: Prompt, assured delivery. Quick affirmation, then concrete action reported. The confidence of someone who checked the box. No apology or hedging—work done.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 長期契約の覚書を整理しましょう
lines.en: Let's organize the memoranda for the long-term contracts.
lines.style: Procedural, clear direction. Slightly lighter pace here—the voice winding through administrative detail with practiced ease. Collaborative framing, but with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。即日対応のオプションを案内します
lines.en: Yes—I'll be announcing the same-day response options.
lines.style: Closing affirmation. Slight warmth underneath the professionalism—a subtle signal that this work is wrapping up on a positive note. Future-facing tone. Confident, not rushed.
